subject: English
question_text: Answer the following questions.
stimulus: a) What does heritage refer to? b) What does the infrastructure of the city reveal? c) Who founded the city and when? d) What did Khan Jahan All do to make the city habitable? e) HOw are the mihra.bs decorated?
guide_solution: (a) Heritage refers to what we inherit from the past, live with in the present and then pass on to our children or future generation. (b) The ; infrastructure of the city reveals significant technical skills in many mosques as well as early Islamic monuments. (c) The Turkish general, a saint warrior Ulugh Khan Jahan founded the city in the 15th century. (d) To make the city habitable, Khan Jahan All built a network of roads, bridges, public buildings and reservoirs. (e) The inihrabs are decorated with stonework and terracotta.
source: SSC English 1st Paper Chattogram Board-2020 (CF Board Ques)
